sources.citation: Masson, Olivier. 1953. Les inscriptions étéochypriotes I: Les pierres d'Amathonte et leur situation actuelle. Syria 30(1-2): 83-88. DOI 10.3406/syria.1953.4957
sources.note: Nothing. Epigraphic note on where the Amathus stones are kept; p. 83 calls the language 'une langue inconnue'. Persée PDF is altcha-gated; page text (scanned, pp. 83-84) saved via reader proxy.

sources.citation: Cannavò, Anna. n.d. Eteocypriot. Mnamon: Ancient Writing Systems in the Mediterranean (Scuola Normale Superiore, Pisa). https://mnamon.sns.it/index.php?page=Lingua&id=12&lang=en
sources.note: Nothing on stress; states inscriptions are 'completely readable' in the syllabic script but the language remains undeciphered (three bilinguals plus c. twenty texts). Bibliography: Friedrich 1932, Masson 1983, Petit 1997-98, Given 1998, Petit 1999, Egetmeyer 2009.

No stress/accent information in any of the three; en: 'syntax and possible inflection or agglutination remain an enigma'; de: decipherment 'bisher schwierig'; ru cites Kharsekin 1976 and a Russian translation of Jones. Not primary.
